REVISED DESIGN
• Covers follow the Ø120 arc in short facets.
• USB-C faces terminate at R63, directly
behind the removable electronics cover.
• Button actuator tips terminate at R60.
• Pockets stop at R92; outer wood stays solid.
• LED channels live above the 3 mm floor.
• No glued cover blocks; screws enter solid
frame ears to eliminate square block pockets.
OPEN / NOT VALIDATED
• MOSFET board size and location are TBD.
• Confirm actual board and connector envelopes.
• Confirm one-piece 24 mm routed frame and
whether pockets are through-cuts or blind.
• This sheet is not router-ready geometry.
WHAT TO REVIEW IN THIS DRAFT
1. Covers and controls visibly hug the center opening; no 106 mm flat chord remains.
2. ESP32-C3 and TP4056 USB-C mouths are accessible immediately after removing the faceted cover.
3. Component pockets end by R92 and do not consume the LED-channel structure above them.
4. Finished pocket and guide-bushing template outlines remain separate deliverables after layout approval.
